title: The canonical etale compactification graph map
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, f : U → X separated and etale, and c = (i : U → Z, g : Z → X) a compactification [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Define the canonical map f_! → g_*i_! (in diagrammatic functor order i_! ⋙ g_*) as follows. In V = Z ×_X U put q = pr_U, v = pr_Z and s = (i,id). The graph s is open and closed. The identity s ≫ q = id and the inverse of the clopen-extension comparison give a projection π : q^* → s_!. Compose the canonical sum-extension base-change isomorphism f_!g^* ≅ q^*v_! with πv_! and the adjunction-preserving composition isomorphism s_!v_! ≅ i_!. Transpose this transformation under g^* ⊣ g_* to obtain etaleCompactificationGraphMap A f c. All maps are constructed, with no arbitrary existential witness. This definition also covers empty schemes and the zero ring.

lean.statement:
def etaleCompactificationGraphMap
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {U X : Scheme.{u}} (u : U ⟶ X) [Etale u] [IsSeparated u]
    (c : Compactification u) :
    etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) u inferInstance ⟶
      openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i ⋙
        lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g
